notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only source is one row in the FFLA inventory, which gives no type, build year or removal date. The West Lookouts North Dakota directory has no Sheyenne entry. The story is about 35 words, below the 120-word floor, because the evidence supports no more without padding. Two searches returned a summary saying the Forest Service Sheyenne National Grassland visitor page mentions a former fire watchtower among its stops. The cached copy of that page did not contain that text, so nothing from it is used. If that watchtower is the Sheyenne structure, the removed status is out of date; if not, a different tower may still stand. A human should check the Forest Service page or the Sheyenne Ranger District before publishing. No photos found.
